text:
maria (Platform PM): Quick sync — bake-off finished. Posting the short results and asking for partner alignment on pinning strategy + hotfix window.

sam (Eng Runtime): TL;DR: CUDA 12.2.1 shows a 3-5% perf regression on medium seqs vs 12.1. We saw a kernel fallback in cudnn path. ROCm 5.8 is fine but has one memcpy hotspot.

anya (Eng-ML): Putting numbers: genbench median latency (token): baseline(CUDA12.1)=42ms, CUDA12.2.1=44.5ms, ROCm5.8=43ms. Variance up ~8% on long contexts.

lee (Partnerships): Can NVIDIA confirm whether 12.2.1 is a known perf regression? We need a statement for marketplace bundles (we're pinning or warning).

cheng (NVIDIA): Cheng here — we're aware of a regression in cuBLAS indirect gemm path for some transformer kernels. Team has an internal patch candidate. Can you share the exact model + seq distribution?

sam (Eng Runtime): Model is transformer-XL style (4096 hidden, 32 heads) used in our perf harness. Short repro snippet below:

```
# repro harness (approx)
python perf_harness.py --model txl-4k --batch 1 --seq 1024 --tokens 2048
# env: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, cuDNN v8.x
```

maria (Platform PM): Marketplace question: raj, if we ship with CUDA12.1 pinned and mark 12.2 as preview, will that block partner marketplace image updates?

raj (Marketplace): Not block, but we need a clear compatibility matrix and a release note callout. If partners want 12.2 images, we can host them under an experimental tag for 30 days before promoting.

cheng (NVIDIA): We'll try the repro. If our patch looks good, timeline for partner hotfix build is ~3 business days (internal CI + validation). Is that acceptable?

lee (Partnerships): That works. Also flagging an SI who requested a certified stack next week — they need a decision by EOD tomorrow whether to go 12.1 pinned or wait.

anya (Eng-ML): From quality side, we prefer pinning to 12.1 for certified stacks until NVIDIA patch is validated. The small perf hit on ROCm isn't worth risk of regressions for enterprise customers.

sam (Eng Runtime): Alternative mitigation: runtime can auto-fallback to an older kernel for known op shapes. We can ship a temporary kernel-override in 48h, but it's a bit invasive (hot reload + CI).

maria (Platform PM): Proposal: 1) Marketplace images: default pin CUDA=12.1, label 12.2-preview; ROCm default 5.8. 2) Notify SIs to use pinned images; offer a canary image with runtime fallback for testing. 3) Cheng to confirm patch ETA by EOD tomorrow.

cheng (NVIDIA): Confirming — will aim to have a candidate by EOD tomorrow and a validated package within 3 business days.

driver-bot: CI job #build-4812 finished: image-cuda12.1-marketplace: success (smoke tests).

lee (Partnerships): I'll draft an external partner note: timeline + recommended pins + who to contact for hotfixes. Will share in this thread shortly.

raj (Marketplace): I'll prepare experimental tags and README changelog entries. Also, need a short blurb for the marketplace tile about the pinning guidance.

maria (Platform PM): Action items: sam -> prep fallback patch PR (48h), cheng -> patch candidate (EOD), lee -> external note (tomorrow AM), raj -> experimental tags + tile blurb. We'll reconvene on this thread after cheng confirms. Thanks :thumbsup:

anya (Eng-ML): Also: let's add a small eval testset that highlights the perf regression so partners can validate their builds. I'll post it to the repo.

sam (Eng Runtime): posting quick perf-diff output for reference:

```
Model txl-4k | seq=1024 | tokens=2048
CUDA12.1 median=42.0ms  p95=58ms
CUDA12.2.1 median=44.5ms p95=68ms  (regression seen on gemm-kernel X)
ROCm5.8 median=43.0ms p95=60ms
```

lee (Partnerships): Nice, that helps. I'll tag Cheng and the SI contacts in the partner note.

cheng (NVIDIA): Got it. Will run the harness and report back with logs and a gist of patched kernels.

maria (Platform PM): Perfect. Closing for now — re-open once we have the patch or if any SI pushes for an immediate exception.

sam (Eng Runtime): :eyes:
